dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Clorinde said Neuvillette offered to deliver her gifts to Wriothesley.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So if we go to the entrance of the Fortress of Meropide, maybe we'll run into Neuvillette!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, we don't know exactly when he'll show up...
